decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered PB-027-06A, Received 6 October 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The access doorway to the premises at 300-302 Chiswick High Road shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until detailed drawings of scale 1:20 of the roller shutters have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be carried out in accordance with that approval.
